body.p: The Evenks came to the ogre. They realised they were ogres. They came and said, "What is this little sack?" They say, "This is how we always got in and this is how we always tightened it![StN]: kur- = hur- 'dive'? That's how we've always played!" They say, "Just get in yourself! We'll see how you get in there. They [the ogres] all went in. They [the Evenks] pulled the strap [they put the strap on] â the sack tightened. The other ogres shouted, "They've pulled it tight! Pulled it tightâ¦ they've killed us, stuffed us in a sack!"[StN]: NB "U!. MurulÄal!" Those who were killed in this way, where [any of them] remained, were killed in this way.
